sn51.15:1.2: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Ānando Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme || || 2.
sn51.15:1.3: Atha kho Uṇṇābho brāhmaṇo yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Ānandena saddhim sammodi ||
sn51.15:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Uṇṇābho brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ Ānandam etad avoca || || 3.
sn51.15:1.5: Kim atthi yaṃ nu kho bho Ānanda samaṇe Gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatī ti || ||
sn51.15:1.6: Chandapahānatthaṃ kho brāhmaṇa Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī ti || || 4.
sn51.15:2.1: Atthi pana bho Ānanda maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa chandassa pahānāyā ti || ||
sn51.15:2.2: Atthi kho brāhmaṇa maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa chandassa pahānāyā ti || || 5.
sn51.15:3.1: Katamo pana bho Ānanda maggo katamā paṭipadā etassa chandassa pahānāyā ti || ||
sn51.15:3.2: Idha brāhmaṇa bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti ||
sn51.15:3.6: ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa maggo ayam paṭipadā etassa chandassa pahānāyā ti || || 6.
sn51.15:4.1: Evaṃ sante kho Ānanda santakaṃ hoti no asantakam
sn51.15:4.2: chandena ca chandam pajahissatī ti netam thānaṃ vijjatīti || ||
sn51.15:4.3: Tena hi brāhmaṇa taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi || yathā te khameyya tathā taṃ vyākareyyāsi || || 7.
sn51.15:4.5: ahosi te pubbe chando Ārāmaṃ gamissāmīti ||
sn51.15:4.6: tassa te ārāmagatassa yo tajjo chando so paṭippassadho ti || ||
sn51.15:4.8: Ahosi te pubbe viriyaṃ Ārāmam gamissāmīti ||
sn51.15:4.9: tassa te ārāmagatassa yaṃ tajjaṃ viriyaṃ tam paṭipassaddhanti || ||
sn51.15:4.11: Ahosi te pubbe cittaṃ Ārāmaṃ gamissāmī ti ||
sn51.15:4.12: tassa te ārāmagatassa yam tajjaṃ cittaṃ tam paṭippassaddhanti || ||
sn51.15:4.14: Ahosi te pubbe vīmaṃsā Ārāmaṃ gamissāmīti ||
sn51.15:4.15: tassa te ārāmagatassa yā tajjā vīmaṃsā sā paṭippassaddhā ti || ||
sn51.15:5.1: Evam eva kho brāhmaṇa yo so bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano sammadaññā vimutto || tassa yo pubbe chando ahosi arahattapattiyā arahatte patte yo tajjo chando so paṭippassaddho || ||
sn51.15:5.2: Yam pubbe viriyam ahosi arahattapattiyā arahatte patte yaṃ tajjaṃ viriyaṃ tam paṭippassaddhaṃ || ||
sn51.15:5.3: Yam pubbe cittam ahosi arahattapattiyā arahatte patte yaṃ tajjaṃ cittaṃ tam paṭippassaddhaṃ || ||
sn51.15:5.4: Yā pubbe vīmaṃsā ahosi arahattapattiyā arahatte patte yā tajjā vīmaṃsā sā paṭippassaddhā || || 9.
sn51.15:5.6: Iti evaṃ sante santakam vā hoti asantakaṃ vā ti || ||
sn51.15:6.1: Addhā bho Ānanda evaṃ sante santakaṃ hoti no asantakaṃ || || 10.
